result.answer: The Creta features page lists comfort amenities including front ventilated seats on select higher variants, dual-zone automatic temperature control, and a panoramic sunroof. According to www.hyundai.com, it also highlights wireless smartphone charging, rear air-conditioning vents, cruise control, and a rear centre armrest with cup holders across the lineup.
